title: Embedding Audio
instructions: The audio question type embeds an HTML5 audio clip from any URL. Like video, it accepts an absolute URL or a path under /static/ — this example uses /static/example_audio.ogg. When force_listen is true, the Continue button stays disabled (with a notice next to it) until the participant has listened to completion_threshold of the clip.

questions.title: 1. Display-only audio (no telemetry, no enforcement)
questions.text: No force_listen, no id. The participant can play, pause, scrub, or skip the clip entirely.

questions.title: 2. Force-listen with telemetry
questions.text: force_listen is on and an id is set, so start time, end time, and accumulated listened seconds are written to the database. A snap-back guard prevents seeking past the supposed playhead, and the Continue button stays disabled until the clip has been listened to.

questions.instructions: After listening, please rate the clip:

q_text.text: The clip played clearly without issue.
The clip was pleasant to listen to.
